senate.description: Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities requirement to designate a flagship institution

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; requiring the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to designate a flagship institution; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 136F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[136F.51] DESIGNATION OF FLAGSHIP INSTITUTION. +]

[+By January 1, 2027, the board must designate a state university as a flagship institution. A flagship institution must: +]

[+(1) have a clearly defined mission and strategic plan that align with faculty hiring and retention and student enrollment; +]

[+(2) demonstrate an exceptional capacity to promote the state's economic development and intellectual advancement; +]

[+(3) be a high-enrollment campus that evidences a continual pattern of growth; +]

[+(4) be granted autonomy, as requested by the institution, from systemwide mandates and operating restrictions; and +]

[+(5) receive priority in capital improvement requests and decisions. +]
additions: By January 1, 2027, the board must designate a state university as a flagship institution. A flagship institution must:
(1) have a clearly defined mission and strategic plan that align with faculty hiring and retention and student enrollment;
(2) demonstrate an exceptional capacity to promote the state's economic development and intellectual advancement;
(3) be a high-enrollment campus that evidences a continual pattern of growth;
(4) be granted autonomy, as requested by the institution, from systemwide mandates and operating restrictions; and
(5) receive priority in capital improvement requests and decisions.
